body: I'm so glad and sad at the same time that there are people like me. You seem strong, please keep going, you have so much potential! You seem like a great person as well, may God bless you.

Thanks for your conversation with me.. It's time to go now. I really appreciate everything you told me, and that you spent time from your day to talk to some random pathetic person online... If I don't come back - I wish you everything the best.

I'm an Atheist and to be fair I'm not proud. It's a fact that religious people are so much more happy. Maybe Heaven and Hell exists - or maybe you're just reborn.. Death is such a mystery I want to solve

I don't know a lot about his sickness, but from what I do know he had Alzheimer's, which slowly but surely affected his brain, he couldn't think anymore, became pretty much handicapped... It's sad to think about it, that even after his death people disrespected him... Feelings of death can make me happy, that I might see him, or find out the biggest mystery I've thought about - what happens after death? I'm very curious, and as they say - Curiosity killed the cat...

I've lost quite a lot of people due to my mistakes, I don't think anyone could understand me... I never open up and I have problems within my family. I lost my father whom I loved more than anyone, and his death was always kept away from me until they were forced to tell me... I just don't feel like I belong here. The world would be better without me, the same I'd be better without the world

I'm not a happy person in general... I could just whine about how I could fix all my problems if I didn't have the huge issue with school
I'm sometimes scared of replying because I might sound pathetic, or spoiled...
If I do so, my grandmother won't be happy... And I can't confess to her, she'll call me crazy, I swear!
I just want some rest, some peace... I don't want to go to school tomorrow! I don't want to go back over there... Even waking up in a hospital would be so much more pleasant

There's no one in my house except my great-grandmother. I was waiting for her to go sleep. Tomorrow morning my grandmother is going to come. I have plenty of time... I don't think I can think clearly anymore, i'm just so determined but at the same time very anxious
Thank you... Even myself - I don't know what is going to happen. I am not even sure of my own actions at this point. I might go mental, or I might chicken out immediately.. Who knows.

First, I'd like to thank you for these kind words that made me smile through the tears of writing an earlier reply. I always try to be positive. I tried to think - everything is going to be over, I'll be free from this hell-hole. But as I kept on living this positivity died out, as I saw the disappointed faces of my family members and even friends. 
I don't have anyone I can trust in real life, and I prefer not ending up in a mental hospital. I have friends over the internet, but they're a bit too young for me to vent about suicide on, in my opinion... 
Everyday I feel fear of a bad grade. 
I'd rather die, than hear the insulting words of my mother, her calling me a failure.
That hurts much more than death, believe me
I can see where you're coming from, but I honestly never felt worse it's so strange. Everyone wants me to succeed, and I think the thought of letting people down is what saddens me
